title: Yxorp config
description: Config for yxorp, a local reverse proxy for rewriting, mocking, and debugging API responses.

target.description: The upstream server everything proxies to by default — an absolute http(s) URL.

proxyPort.description: Port for the local proxy server.

proxyHeaders.description: Extra headers sent with every proxied request.

secure.description: Verify the target's TLS certificate (default false).

changeOrigin.description: Rewrite the Host header to the target's host (default true).

cors.description: Answer CORS preflights and add CORS headers to every response.

https.description: Serve the proxy over HTTPS (and WSS). Requires a restart to change.

key.description: Path to the PEM private key.

remoteRules.description: Route matching paths to a different target.

staticRules.description: Serve local files for a URL path prefix.

mockRules.description: Answer matching requests locally — the target never sees them.

rewriteRules.description: Let matching requests reach the target, then modify the response.

path.description: path-to-regexp v8 pattern matched against the URL path (query string excluded), e.g. /api/users/:id or /api/*rest.

origin.description: Allowed origin(s); "*" or omitted allows any origin.

exposeHeaders.description: Response headers the page's JavaScript may read.

target.description: Absolute URL. Without a path only the host changes; with a path (e.g. http://localhost:4000/v2/:id) it replaces the request path.

ws.description: Route WebSocket upgrades instead of HTTP requests.

path.description: URL path prefix, matched on whole segments.

directory.description: Local directory to serve files from.

directoryIndex.description: Default file for directory requests, e.g. index.html.

match.description: Extra conditions: every listed query param / request header must have exactly this value.

script.description: Module exporting the handler (.js, .cjs, .mjs, or .ts on Node 22.18+).

json.description: Respond with this value as JSON.
